description:
## Summary of PR

This PR removes unused subscription-related frontend code that is no longer referenced in the application.

Fix #12551 

The cleanup includes:
- Removing unused subscription components and hooks
- Removing unused billing API methods and related types
- Ensuring no dangling imports or references remain

This reduces maintenance overhead and keeps the frontend codebase clean and consistent.

## Demo Screenshots/Videos

Not applicable – this PR removes unused code and does not affect UI behavior.

## Change Type

- [x] Refactor (code cleanup, no behavior change)

## Checklist

- [x] Code compiles successfully
- [x] No TypeScript errors
- [x] Changes match the acceptance criteria of issue #12551
